list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden, 1,000 Gamerscore on Xbox, 0 online trophies
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words for this entry. Trophies with status unconfirmed are the 28 hidden trophies whose unlock method is not confirmed in public sources yet: their guide says so and invents no method.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first. This platinum pops on its own once the full list is done, so follow the roadmap in this guide and treat it as the finish line, not a trophy you chase directly.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of the story and see it through to the end. It unlocks as part of the opening chapter, so you cannot miss it if you keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, so clear the chapter's mission markers one by one and do not rush past the side jobs that feed into it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the chapter closes; work through the chapter in story order and it will come naturally.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, so keep following the story markers until the chapter's final mission is done.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes; it is the last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Save before you start it, so you can replay the ending and then mop up anything left in free roam afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Follow the mission markers to the end of the job and the trophy pops at the debrief.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Plan the job, follow the heist steps in order, and keep a fast getaway vehicle ready for the escape.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story. Finish all of its objectives to the end of the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Stay with the mission markers until the finale of that job; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Expect a heavy airport response, so plan your exit route before you trigger the takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Stock up on armour and ammo first, as it is a long combat mission, then work through its objectives in order.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. That means the story, all stranger strands, activities and collectibles the in-game checklist tracks; finish everything else first and this gold is the reward for the cleanup.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Jumps, near-misses and airtime all count, so use fast bikes and the stunt jumps dotted around Leonida and repeat them; the counter keeps climbing across sessions.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, racing, the shooting range, bowling, arcade games, drone racing and the rest. One try of each is enough, so sample them early and tick this off cheaply.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practise one weapon class at a time, learn the target pattern, and replay a challenge until the gold score lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its 14 locations. Learn one course at a time and keep the drone low through the gates; a win at a new location is what counts.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Road, off-road and street races all count, but each race only counts the first time you win it, so keep moving to new races instead of repeating one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Use the best rod and bait you have, keep the line tension steady, and land the bigger catch before time runs out.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade game to the end of one full game. The cabinets are in arcades and bars around Vice City, so pick a game you enjoy and finish a single run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. His jobs appear as you progress the story, so check for his marker after story beats.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow his strand's jobs in order until the final one unlocks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. His final job is the strand's payoff, so work through his earlier jobs first.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Talk to every stranger you meet, follow each strand to its end, and count the finished strands as you go.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. His jobs unlock as the story moves on, so return to his marker between chapters.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Clear his earlier jobs first and the final mission will open up.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
